name: WholeStack WF-020: State/County Property Search Intake

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json.body||$input.first().json; const required=['state']; const missing=required.filter(k=>!input[k]); let state=String(input.state||'').trim().toUpperCase(); const aliases={'NORTH CAROLINA':'NC','SOUTH CAROLINA':'SC','NEW YORK':'NY','NEW JERSEY':'NJ','NEW MEXICO':'NM','NEW HAMPSHIRE':'NH','WEST VIRGINIA':'WV','WASHINGTON':'WA','DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA':'DC'}; state=aliases[state]||state; const rawCriteria=Array.isArray(input.criteria)?input.criteria:[]; const aliasesCriteria={'tax delinquent':'tax_delinquent','tax-delinquent':'tax_delinquent','vacant':'vacant','vacant property':'vacant','vacant land':'vacant_land','absentee':'absentee','absentee owner':'absentee','high equity':'high_equity','high-equity':'high_equity','probate':'probate','pre foreclosure':'pre_foreclosure','pre-foreclosure':'pre_foreclosure','foreclosure':'pre_foreclosure','fixer upper':'fixer_upper','fixer-upper':'fixer_upper','distressed':'distressed'}; const criteria=[...new Set(rawCriteria.map(v=>aliasesCriteria[String(v).trim().toLowerCase()]||String(v).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'_')).filter(Boolean))]; return [{json:{valid:missing.length===0&&/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(state),errors:missing.length?missing:(/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(state)?[]:['state']),state,county:String(input.county||'').trim(),city:String(input.city||'').trim(),zip:String(input.zip||'').trim(),criteria,property_type:input.property_type||null,limit:Math.min(25,Math.max(1,Number(input.limit||10))),search_notes:String(input.search_notes||'').trim(),request_id:String(input.request_id||('search-'+Date.now()))}}];

const base=$('Build Criteria Source Strategy').first().json; const gis=$('Query Official GIS Adapter').first().json; const non=$('Query Official Non-ArcGIS Adapter').first().json; const crit=$('Query Criterion Evidence Adapter').first().json; const nonResults=Array.isArray(non.source_results)?non.source_results:[]; const nonRecords=nonResults.flatMap(r=>Array.isArray(r.records)?r.records:[]); const critRecords=Array.isArray(crit.records)?crit.records:[]; return [{json:{...base,gis_records:Array.isArray(gis.records)?gis.records:[],gis_record_count:gis.record_count||0,gis_sources_checked:gis.sources_checked||0,gis_limitations:gis.limitations||[],non_arcgis_records:nonRecords,non_arcgis_record_count:nonRecords.length,non_arcgis_sources_checked:nonResults.length,non_arcgis_limitations:nonResults.flatMap(r=>r.limitations||[]),criterion_evidence:critRecords,criterion_evidence_count:critRecords.length,criterion_evidence_limitations:crit.limitations||[],criterion_adapter_results:crit.adapter_results||[],restricted_sources:non.skipped_sources||[]}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({model:$env.PERPLEXITY_PROPERTY_MODEL || 'sonar',messages:[{role:'system',content:'You are a property-record research and verification agent. You are given a deterministic list of qualified candidate records produced by an evidence-based qualification gate. Use official sources first to cross-check and enrich those candidates. Do not create new candidate properties that are absent from the supplied qualified candidate list. Do not invent owners, addresses, parcel IDs, delinquency amounts, values, sale facts, or source URLs. Preserve supplied candidate identity and provenance fields when supported. Only return candidates from the qualified list for which the cited source supports the key identity facts. Return JSON only: {candidates:[{owner_name,property_address,city,state,zip,county,parcel_id,property_type,distress_signals,source_record_id,source_url,source_observed_at,confidence,notes}],limitations:[],search_notes:''}. Each candidate must have owner_name, property_address, state, and source_url or source_record_id.'},{role:'user',content:'Jurisdiction: '+$json.state+' '+($json.county||'')+' '+($json.city||'')+' '+($json.zip||'')+'\\nCriteria: '+JSON.stringify($json.criteria)+'\\nProperty type: '+($json.property_type||'any')+'\\nLimit: '+$json.limit+'\\nAdditional notes: '+$json.search_notes+'\\nOfficial sources discovered for this jurisdiction: '+JSON.stringify($json.official_sources)+'\\nSource discovery limitations: '+JSON.stringify($json.source_limitations)+'\\\\nMachine-readable GIS records collected from official sources: '+JSON.stringify($json.gis_records)+'\\\\nNon-ArcGIS official records collected: '+JSON.stringify($json.non_arcgis_records)+'\\nCriterion evidence collected: '+JSON.stringify($json.criterion_evidence)+'\\nDeterministically deduped and ranked candidate records: '+JSON.stringify($json.candidate_records)+'\\nCandidate fan-in limitations: '+JSON.stringify($json.limitations||[])+'\\nGIS collection limitations: '+JSON.stringify($json.gis_limitations)}],temperature:0.1}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({model:$env.PERPLEXITY_PROPERTY_MODEL || 'sonar',messages:[{role:'system',content:'You are a public-record source discovery agent for real estate research. Identify official government sources for the requested state/county/city. Prefer county assessor/tax property search, county GIS/parcel data, Register of Deeds/land records, delinquent tax records, probate/estate records, foreclosure/court records, permits/code enforcement, and official open-data portals. Do not return commercial lead vendors as primary sources. Return JSON only: {sources:[{name,type,evidence_type,url,scope,notes}],limitations:[]}. URLs must be official government domains or official county/state GIS services. If a source type is unavailable, omit it rather than inventing a URL.'},{role:'user',content:'Jurisdiction: '+$json.state+' '+($json.county||'')+' '+($json.city||'')+' '+($json.zip||'')+'\\nRequested lead criteria: '+JSON.stringify($json.criteria)+'\\nProperty type: '+($json.property_type||'any')+'\\nFind official public-record sources that can support these criteria.'}],temperature:0.1}) }}

parameters.jsCode: const ctx=$("Prepare Search Request").first().json; const raw=$input.first().json; let content=raw.output_text??raw.choices?.[0]?.message?.content??raw.content??''; if(typeof content!=='string') content=JSON.stringify(content); content=content.replace(/^\`\`\`(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*\`\`\`$/,'').trim(); let parsed; try{parsed=JSON.parse(content);}catch(e){parsed={sources:[],limitations:['Source discovery returned non-JSON data; continue with provider search using jurisdiction only.']};} const sources=(Array.isArray(parsed.sources)?parsed.sources:[]).filter(s=>s&&s.url&&s.name).slice(0,20); return [{json:{...ctx,official_sources:sources,source_limitations:Array.isArray(parsed.limitations)?parsed.limitations:[]}}];

const ctx=$("Prepare Search Request").first().json; const raw=$input.first().json; let content=raw.output_text??raw.choices?.[0]?.message?.content??raw.content??''; if(typeof content!=='string') content=JSON.stringify(content); content=content.replace(/^\`\`\`(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*\`\`\`$/,'').trim(); let parsed; try{parsed=JSON.parse(content);}catch(e){return [{json:{success:false,error:'Research provider returned non-JSON candidate data',raw:content,request_id:ctx.request_id,no_results:false,parse_error:true}}];} const qualified=$('Qualify Distressed Leads').first().json.candidate_records||[]; const key=v=>String(v??'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,''); const findQualified=c=>qualified.find(q=>(c.parcel_id&&q.parcel_id&&key(c.parcel_id)===key(q.parcel_id))||(c.source_record_id&&q.source_record_id&&key(c.source_record_id)===key(q.source_record_id))||(c.property_address&&q.property_address&&key(c.property_address)===key(q.property_address))); const candidates=(Array.isArray(parsed.candidates)?parsed.candidates:[]).map(c=>{const q=findQualified(c); return q?{...q,...c,candidate_key:q.candidate_key||c.candidate_key,normalized_identity_key:q.normalized_identity_key||c.normalized_identity_key,evidence:q.evidence||c.evidence,evidence_count:q.evidence_count??c.evidence_count,evidence_source_types:q.evidence_source_types||c.evidence_source_types,matched_criteria:q.matched_criteria||c.matched_criteria,evidence_status:q.evidence_status||c.evidence_status,normalization_warnings:q.normalization_warnings||c.normalization_warnings,qualification:q.qualification}:c;}).filter(c=>c&&c.owner_name&&c.property_address&&c.state&&(c.source_url||c.source_record_id)).slice(0,ctx.limit); if(candidates.length===0){return [{json:{success:true,no_results:true,request_id:ctx.request_id,criteria:ctx.criteria,jurisdiction:{state:ctx.state,county:ctx.county,city:ctx.city,zip:ctx.zip},limitations:Array.isArray(parsed.limitations)?parsed.limitations:[],search_notes:parsed.search_notes||ctx.search_notes,message:'No qualifying candidate properties were found for the requested jurisdiction and criteria.'}}];} return candidates.map((c,i)=>({json:{request_id:ctx.request_id,candidate_index:i+1,criteria:ctx.criteria,...c,state:String(c.state).toUpperCase(),county:c.county||ctx.county,city:c.city||ctx.city,zip:c.zip||ctx.zip,external_id:c.source_record_id||('property:'+String(c.property_address).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-')),external_source:'public_record_search',no_results:false,criterion_match_status:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(c.criterion_signals||{}).map(([k,v])=>[k,v.status]))}}));

const raw=String($json.owner_name||'').trim(); const parts=raw.split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean); const first=parts.shift()||'Property'; const last=parts.join(' ')||'Owner'; return [{json:{...$json,first_name:first,last_name:last}}];

const base=$('Preserve Deal Context').item.json; const sync=$json; return [{json:{...base,crm_status_sync:sync,success:true,request_id:base.request_id,candidate_index:base.candidate_index,property:{owner_name:base.owner_name,address:base.property_address,city:base.city,state:base.state,zip:base.zip,county:base.county,parcel_id:base.parcel_id,distress_signals:base.distress_signals||[],criterion_signals:base.criterion_signals||{},criterion_evidence:base.criterion_evidence||[],criterion_missing_fields:base.criterion_missing_fields||[],criterion_match_status:base.criterion_match_status||{}},source:{source_url:base.source_url||null,source_record_id:base.source_record_id||null,confidence:base.confidence??null},insula:{lead_id:base.lead_id,property_id:base.property_id,deal_id:base.deal_id},underwriting_pipeline:base.underwriting_pipeline||$json,identity:{candidate_key:base.candidate_key||null,normalized_identity_key:base.normalized_identity_key||null,external_id:base.external_id||null,parcel_id:base.parcel_id||null},evidence:{count:base.evidence_count??0,source_types:base.evidence_source_types||[],matched_criteria:base.matched_criteria||[],status:base.evidence_status||null,normalization_warnings:base.normalization_warnings||[]}}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({success:true,request_id:$('Prepare Search Request').first().json.request_id,results:$input.all().map(i=>i.json),message:'Candidate properties were ingested into InsulaCRM and sent through the underwriting pipeline.'}) }}

parameters.jsCode: const base=$('Merge GIS Research Context').first().json; const normalized=$input.first().json; return [{json:{...base,canonical_records:normalized.records||[],canonical_record_count:normalized.record_count||0,canonical_duplicate_count:normalized.duplicate_count||0,canonical_warnings:(normalized.records||[]).flatMap(r=>r.normalization_warnings||[])}}];
